minor.name: Outplayed
minor.card: its next d20 roll is made twice, taking the lower

severe.name: Fortune's fool
severe.card: Incapacitated as everything it tries goes wrong

offensive.name: Gambler's Luck
offensive.description: The dice decide — but you hold the table.

tiers.text: When casting a single-target effect, roll a d20 after it resolves. On 1–10 gain a minor benefit (heal 1d4 HP or gain advantage on your next roll). On 11–20 the effect's duration increases by 1 round.
tiers.card: After a single-target effect roll d20 — 1–10 a minor boon, 11–20 +1 round duration

tiers.text: Expand the table — on 1–5 gain a second minor benefit (temp HP or reaction recharge). On 6–15 the spell rerolls ones or its duration increases. On 16–20 redirect the spell to a second target with the same effect.
tiers.card: 1–5 a second boon · 6–15 reroll 1s or extend · 16–20 redirect to a second target

tiers.text: Gambler's Luck now applies to multi-target and AoE effects — roll once per target or zone and apply individually.
tiers.card: Applies to multi-target and AoE too — roll per target or zone

tiers.text: Once per long rest, roll a Fortune Die (d100) after the effect resolves. On 1–20: Legendary Surge — you fully heal and restore one expended spell slot. On 21–90: the spell is maximized. On 91–100: the primary target suffers a Luck Implosion — they lose all reactions, take double damage from the next hit, and gain one level of Misfortune for 1 minute.
tiers.card: 1/long rest d100 — 1–20 full heal and a slot back · 21–90 maximised · 91–100 the wild result

supportive.name: Fated Outcome
supportive.description: You rewrite the moment fate would have failed.

tiers.text: When making an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, add +1d4 to the roll.
tiers.card: +1d4 to an attack, check or save

tiers.text: Whenever you roll with advantage, roll three times and take the best result.
tiers.card: Advantage becomes roll three, take the best

tiers.text: After failing a roll you may choose to reroll it entirely. This can only be used once per effect.
tiers.card: Reroll one failed roll entirely, once per effect

tiers.text: Once per long rest, declare a critical hit or automatic success on any roll made by you or a creature within 60 feet. Must be declared before the roll is made.
tiers.card: 1/long rest declare an auto-success or crit for you or anyone within 60 ft — before the roll

supportive.name: Serendipitous Casting
supportive.description: Chaos still dances — but it dances toward you.

tiers.text: When your effect involves random damage, targets, or table outcomes, roll twice and choose the better result.
tiers.card: Random outcomes roll twice, take the better

tiers.text: Roll three times and choose the best. You may also replace one d6 with a d8, or grant yourself advantage on one d20 roll tied to the effect.
tiers.card: Roll three · swap a d6 for a d8, or grant yourself advantage on one d20

buff.advantage: one d20 roll tied to the effect

tiers.text: Roll four times, and convert one randomized outcome into a fixed result of your choice (e.g. select a Wild Magic Surge result rather than rolling).
tiers.card: Roll four · fix one randomised outcome to whatever you choose

tiers.text: Roll five times, and trigger a Fortunate Chaos Surge — a random beneficial effect (such as Bless, Mirror Image, or Expeditious Retreat) activates in addition to the spell, centered on you or one ally of your choice.
tiers.card: Roll five · a Fortunate Chaos Surge fires a free benefit alongside the effect

control.name: Fortune's Edge
control.description: The odds favor those who act boldly. (Save: Wisdom)

tiers.text: When your effect targets multiple creatures, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, one target of your choice automatically fails or succeeds their saving throw.
tiers.card: Multi-target effects: d6, on 5–6 one target auto-fails or auto-succeeds

tiers.text: Trigger on a 4–6, and you may now choose two creatures to apply this to rather than one.
tiers.card: Triggers on 4–6 · choose two creatures

tiers.text: You no longer roll — simply choose one creature per effect to automatically succeed or fail their save.
tiers.card: No roll — just choose one creature per effect to auto-pass or auto-fail

tiers.text: Once per long rest, declare a Fate Twist — up to three targets automatically experience the result you dictate (fail, succeed, ignore the effect, or repeat it). Recharges on a natural 20.
tiers.card: 1/long rest Fate Twist — dictate the result for up to three targets · recharges on a natural 20

utility.name: Long Odds
utility.description: Lucky because, on some level, the world decided they deserved to be.

tiers.text: Find something lost or hidden nearby by wandering into it. Win any game of pure chance. Arrive exactly when you are needed, having left at the ordinary time.
tiers.card: Wander into what's lost · win any game of pure chance · arrive exactly when needed

tiers.text: For 8 hours, small things go your way — a door unlocked, a guard looking elsewhere, a seat at a full table, a name remembered. The weather favors your journey.
tiers.card: 8 hrs of small mercies — unlocked doors, a guard looking away, weather in your favour

tiers.text: Once in a day, a mundane disaster simply misses you and your companions — the bridge holds, the ambush chooses another road, the ship makes port.
tiers.card: 1/day a mundane disaster simply misses you — the bridge holds, the ambush takes another road

tiers.text: Name something you need — a person, an object, a passage, an answer. Within a day, chance brings you to it, or it to you. How is never up to you.
tiers.card: Name what you need · within a day chance brings you to it. How is never up to you

complementEffects.name: Lucky Strike
complementEffects.description: Fortune tips the scales at the last moment.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, the target takes bonus damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6).
effect.card: d6 on a hit — 4+ adds a damage die of the primary type

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Triggers on a 3 or higher, and on a 6 the effect may jump to a second target within 15 feet for the same bonus damage.
upgrades.card: Triggers on 3+ · a 6 jumps the bonus to a second target within 15 ft

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Bonus damage increases to two dice, and a roll of 5 or 6 also causes the target to have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
upgrades.card: Two dice · 5–6 also gives disadvantage on their next attack

complementEffects.name: Windfall
complementEffects.description: A brush with fortune leaves something behind.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, one ally within 30 feet may reroll one die of their choice on the next roll they make before the start of your next turn, taking the new result.
effect.card: An ally within 30 ft rerolls one die on their next roll

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The ally also regains HP equal to your spellcasting modifier.
Level 11+: Choose two allies to receive this benefit. Each may reroll two dice instead of one on their next roll.
upgrades.card: Two allies · each rerolls two dice

complementEffects.name: Twist of Fate
complementEffects.description: What fortune gives, it can just as easily take away.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw vs your Verum DC or have disadvantage on the next roll they make before the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Wis save {DC} or disadvantage on their next roll

penalty.disadvantage: the next roll they make before the end of their ne

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Disadvantage extends to all rolls the target makes until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: Disadvantage on all their rolls until end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Creatures that fail also cannot benefit from advantage on any roll until the end of their next turn.
upgrades.card: They also can't benefit from advantage at all

buff.advantage: any roll until the end of their next turn
